$schema: Machine-readable mirror of src/app/globals.css. Source of truth is the code — regenerate this file by hand whenever globals.css changes, in the same commit. See design-concpet/brand-guidelines.md for the human-readable version with rationale.

brand.name: R²χTECH
brand.tagline: We automate AEC. You ship faster.
brand.descriptor: Computational automation studio for architecture, engineering and construction.

dark._note: edge was #5a6368 (3.19:1 on carbon, 2.93:1 on graphite — failing against a surface). Current value clears 3.44:1 / 3.15:1 against both.

warm._note: Redefines carbon/graphite/line/fg/fgMuted, plus edge and danger (added — this scope silently inherited dark-scope edge before, at 1.87:1). Accent/accentInk/onAccent/focus still inherit from dark scope unchanged.

pale._note: Redefines carbon/graphite/line/fg AND the three accent-ink-role tokens (accentInk, focus, edge), plus danger. --color-accent itself is never redefined — it stays #e8a94a everywhere, used only as a filled plate on this ground.

labOnly._note: Used only inside Home's own dark-scope context (the hero's greige plate and the panel charcoal), never a scope selector. panelInkMuted is new: --color-fg-muted (tuned for carbon, 6.08:1) drops to 3.55:1 on --color-panel, which is much lighter than carbon.

rules: Amber text/border/hairline anywhere => use the accentInk token, never the literal accent hex.
Amber as a filled button/plate => use accent + onAccent, on any ground.
Amber is structurally illegible as ink on the pale ground (1.00:1) — this cannot be fixed by choosing a darker amber; see brand-guidelines.md §2.4.

Meaningful borders/lines (fields, controls, diagram structure, table rows, grid-card dividers, checklist checkboxes) => edge token, not line (line is 1.37:1, decorative only). 'Meaningful' means: if this line disappearing would change what the reader understands, it is edge.
Error text and invalid-field borders => danger token, scoped per ground the same way accentInk is — never an unscoped Tailwind colour like text-red-400.
A component must carry data-site-pale if it visually sits on the pale ground, even if it renders outside the page's own [data-site-pale] wrapper div.
When toggling data-site-pale from a boolean prop, guard with `value || undefined` — a literal `data-site-pale="false"` still matches the CSS attribute selector.

Never dilute an accent border with alpha (border-accent/40) to make it 'softer' — alpha does not change relative luminance against an opaque background, so it is exactly as illegible on the pale ground as full-opacity amber. Use accentInk at full opacity instead.
Never hardcode an accent-derived rgba() literal in a gradient; use color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) N%, transparent) inside the arbitrary Tailwind value.

surface.usage: Container, card, panel, media frame, text field (including textarea)

control.usage: Button, chip, toggle, badge, small circular marker

radius._note: Exactly two values, everywhere. Before this the codebase carried six (rounded-full, -lg, -xl, -md, -sm, bare rounded) mixed within single components. A text field is 'surface' even though it is interactive — it holds content the way a card does, it does not trigger an action the way a button does.

sans.usage: Body and UI text (also the document default)

lead._note: Defined, not yet used anywhere in the codebase.

exceptions: HeroOverlay.tsx headline + scroll statements: bespoke clamp() values tuned against the geodesic model's measured mobile clearance. Do not migrate onto the shared scale.
Panels.tsx AboutPanel lead paragraph: bespoke clamp(1.25rem,2.2vw,2rem) at leading-1.45 — justified running prose, not a heading.

breakpoints._note: Tailwind's default md and 2xl are cleared (--breakpoint-*: initial) and do not exist.

logo.technique: CSS mask-image, recoloured per scope via background-color — never rendered as a plain .
lockups: R² favicon glyph, auto-cropped by scripts/favicon.mjs
logo.clearSpaceDefault: ~1 cap-height (not yet formally specified in code)
